source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Warhammer Event Missions use the Chapter Approved Mission Deck with no card amendments. Its FAQ rulings:

- VP gained as the battle ends ignore the 15VP-per-round limit; that moment is separate from the end of round 5.
- Removing an operation marker a mission action placed also removes the status that action gave (such as decoyed).
- Operation markers come off the battlefield only as your Primary Mission card allows; if it says nothing, they stay.
- Death Trap: the terrain area need not be trapped yet when the enemy unit is destroyed.
- Surveil the Foe: an enemy unit surveilled while in range of an objective holding an operation marker still counts if you remove that marker later the same turn.
- Vital Link: with more than 1 central objective, cumulative VP count for your operation markers in any central objective you control.
- Plunder: ‘not within your territory’ refers to the terrain area.
- Beacon: if the chosen Beacon unit is destroyed before the card is achieved, you cannot pick another and the card cannot be achieved; discarding it in your turn gains 1 CP.
